problem:
$$
{v}_{1}=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ 1 \\ 2\end{aligned}],\,{v}_{2}=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ -2 \\ -4\end{aligned}],\,{v}_{3}=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 2 \\ -1\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the vectors shown above. Given that the inner product in the vector space ${R}^{3}$ is defined as 

$$
⟨x,y⟩=2{x}_{1}{y}_{1}+{x}_{2}{y}_{2}+{x}_{3}{y}_{3},
$$

which of the following statements are true?

- ${v}_{1}⊥{v}_{2}$ with respect to the given inner product
- ${v}_{1}⊥̸{v}_{3}$ with respect to the given inner product
- $S={{v}_{1},{v}_{2},{v}_{3}}$ is an orthogonal set with respect to the given inner product

choices.value: None of the statements is true

activity_context.topic_title: Orthogonal Sets in Inner Product Spaces
